content: the Low-level encoder encodes each entity $e_i$ on the basis of its record embeddings $\mathbf {r}_{i,j}$. Each record embedding $\mathbf {r}_{i,j}$ is compared to other record embeddings to learn its final hidden representation $\mathbf {h}_{i,j}$. Furthermore, we add a special record [ENT] for each entity, illustrated in Figure FIGREF11 as the last record. Since entities might have a variable number of records, this token allows to aggregate final hidden record representations $\lbrace \mathbf {h}_{i,j}\rbrace _{j=1}^{J_i}$ in a fixed-sized representation vector $\mathbf {h}_{i}$.
